headline: Prayer Practice, from entry to detail
overview: Practice prayer across 15+ traditions including Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Buddhism, Hinduism. Access guided prayers, track your practice, and deepen your spiritual connection across diverse faith traditions.
targetAudience: Users interested in spirituality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Access prayers from 15+ faith traditions including Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Buddhism, and Hinduism
Track your daily prayer practice and streaks
Guided prayer experiences tailored to each tradition
Deepen spiritual connection with diverse prayer forms and intentions
tips: Explore traditions beyond your own — many prayers share universal themes of gratitude, compassion, and surrender.
Set a consistent time each day for prayer to build the habit; even a brief 2-minute practice maintains momentum.
